head_commit.message:
Improve plugin install failure analytics (#37645)

## Why

Plugin install failures need stable, low-cardinality details that distinguish
actionable causes without relying on error messages.

## What changed

- Add HTTP status subtypes for remote catalog, mutation, and bundle download
  failures, including specific common statuses and a general `http_5xx` bucket.
- Emit failure analytics when a remote plugin is disabled by an administrator or
  unavailable under its install policy.
- Preserve marketplace I/O, configuration, and task failure subtypes, including
  failures that occur before a plugin ID can be resolved.

## Testing

Add app-server coverage for catalog and install HTTP failures, unavailable
remote plugins, unreadable marketplace files, and oversized bundle error
responses.

  failures that occur before a plugin ID can be resolved.

remote plugins, unreadable marketplace files, and oversized bundle error
responses.

head_commit.message:
Include buffered turns when editing prompts (#37622)

## Why

Prompt editing looks up the selected user message in the thread's turns, but
new live turns may still exist only in the replay buffer.

## What changed

Reconstruct buffered turns from turn and item notifications before locating
the prompt to edit. Preserve completion metadata and avoid duplicating turns
or items already present in the snapshot.

## Testing

Extend the prompt-edit fork test to cover a selected turn supplied through the
replay buffer and verify that the source thread remains unchanged.
